Package bg.tu_varna.ks.models

package bg.tu_varna.ks.models
Domain models of the calendar system.

This package defines the two core types: Calendar (a singleton representing the complete state of the open calendar) and Event (a single concrete event/meeting). The classes are annotated for use with JAXB and can be serialized to and deserialized from XML.
